title: Application for 品牌营销实习生 | Haru Media
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

My name is Eunseok, and I am writing to apply for the Brand Marketing Internship at Haru Media. I am very interested in your work in brand campaigns and digital content, and I would be grateful for the opportunity to learn from your team.

Through my university projects, I have developed an interest in social media planning, audience research and campaign coordination. I am organised, eager to learn, and willing to take on both creative and administrative tasks. I understand that I still have much to learn, but I would approach this opportunity with sincerity and care.

Please find my CV attached for your consideration. Thank you very much for your time. I would welcome the chance to discuss my application in an interview.

Kind regards,
Eunseok

title: Application for Content & Social Media Intern | Morrow Studio
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I hope you are doing well. My name is Eunseok, and I would like to apply for the Content and Social Media Internship at Morrow Studio.

I enjoy planning content, paying attention to visual details and learning how brands communicate with their audiences. I would love to support your team with content calendars, research, organising materials and day-to-day production tasks.

Although I am still building professional experience, I am dependable and ready to learn. I have attached my CV and would be very thankful if you could consider my application.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Eunseok

title: Application for Marketing Assistant Intern | Lumi Creative
body:
Dear Recruitment Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing Assistant Internship at Lumi Creative.

I am especially interested in campaign planning, brand communication and social media. I believe an internship with your team would allow me to develop practical skills while contributing to ongoing projects. I am comfortable with research, preparing presentation materials and working carefully to deadlines.

I have enclosed my CV for your review. I would be grateful for the opportunity to be considered and am happy to provide any additional information.

Thank you very much for reading my application.

Best regards,
Eunseok

title: Application for 品牌营销实习生（补充材料） | Haru Media
body:
Dear Recruitment Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I recently submitted my application for the Brand Marketing Internship and wanted to follow up with an updated copy of my CV.

I remain very interested in the opportunity to join Haru Media. I would be happy to assist with campaign schedules, social media reporting and coordination tasks, and I am enthusiastic about learning from your team.

I apologise for taking up your time and sincerely appreciate your consideration. Please find my updated CV attached.

Kind regards,
Eunseok

title: Application for Digital Marketing Intern | Aster Communications
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

My name is Eunseok, and I am applying for the Digital Marketing Internship at Aster Communications.

I am interested in digital campaigns, content performance and the process of turning ideas into clear, engaging communications. I would be glad to help with scheduling posts, collecting data, organising project files and preparing reports.

I know that I am at the beginning of my career, but I am motivated, careful with details and committed to improving. My CV is attached for your review.

Thank you for considering my application. I would greatly appreciate the chance to speak with your team.

Yours sincerely,
Eunseok
